_: SWDY interest-bearing debt by currency of borrowing, and the company's own disclosed average rate per currency. Committed 08-09-2026 under [R-COC-01 AMENDED 08-09-2026]. [R-COC-01] refuses a cost of debt below its own sovereign ON AN ALL-LOCAL-CURRENCY BOOK and separately carries FX debt at LOCAL-EQUIVALENT cost; nothing anywhere established which kind of book this is, so the floor was applied unconditionally at every origin.
why_it_matters: Measured across the whole cash-flow lens before this was written, the sovereign floor binds on 16 of 16 cells: no name's independently computed effective rate reaches the Egyptian sovereign at any origin. On this name the floor replaced observed rates of 4.12/5.39/5.45/4.87 per cent with 18.15/14.30/14.45/22.35, at debt weights up to 58 per cent.
route: text_layer via pdftotext -layout on the company's own audited consolidated financial statements. Every figure carried here foots against a printed total on its own page; where a printed cell is damaged in extraction the figure is RECOVERED BY THE TABLE'S OWN TWO IDENTITIES (its row total and its column total) and the recovery is named, and where a row cannot be made to foot both ways it is REFUSED rather than repaired.
scope: Borrowings only -- long- and short-term loans plus banks credit facilities and overdraft. Trade and notes payables are excluded: they bear no interest, and including them is [R-FCAL-01] trap (i).

2020.total_debt_source: the valuation-input block for this origin, bank overdraft and short-term loans plus long-term loans
2020.note: note 45, foreign currency risk, FY2020 audited consolidated statements. Loans 950/953/529/41 and facilities 2734/71/-/1200 against printed row totals 2473 and 4005. 2020.rates_note: note 45, interest rate risk, 'The average interest rates are as follows: LE 10, EURO 2.87, USD 3.5' -- an ALL-IN table, not a margin over a benchmark, so no external reference rate is needed.

2022.reason: THE PER-CURRENCY SPLIT DOES NOT FOOT AND IS REFUSED RATHER THAN REPAIRED. Note 45.8 of the FY2022 statements is denominated in FOREIGN CURRENCY millions with an EGP total column. The loans row foots to the pound (USD 120 x 24.78 + EUR 35 x 26.37 + SAR 127 x 6.6 = 4735 against a printed 4733), and the facilities row does NOT (USD 162 + EUR 20 + GBP 8 + KWD 7 converts to 5346 against a printed 4303). The FX borrowing TOTAL is sound -- 4733 + 4303 = 9036, and the liabilities column foots 7444+4733+4303=16480 -- but the rates cannot be weighted onto a split that does not reproduce. Arithmetic is the arbiter, not the extractor's confidence: the floor stands at this origin and the gap is named.
